errors.text: The proposed CoCrFeNiTi composition does not reconstruct the MgAlTiVFeCo lightweight alloy system or its ball-milled single-BCC initial state.
The proposed SPS range of 1200–1300 °C is incompatible with the target upper limit of 1000 °C, which is imposed by magnesium volatilization.
None of the cited evidence establishes oxidation performance, Cr2O3 protection, or the stated mass gain for CoCrFeNiTi at 650 °C.
The aqueous-corrosion prediction and numerical corrosion-rate threshold are not supported by the cited evidence; E3 concerns a different alloy in molten chloride salt.
The falsification criterion is logically inverted: poorer properties at 1400 °C would support, rather than falsify, an optimum at 1200–1300 °C.
